name: Purpose Of Man
overview: Scripture reveals that the purpose of man is rooted in being created in God's image, entrusted with dominion over the earth and its creatures, as established in Genesis 1:26 and 1:28. Man's calling includes fruitful multiplication and responsible stewardship under God's authority. Furthermore, true blessing and fulfillment come from fearing the Lord and walking in His ways (Psalms 128:1), acknowledging that the Lord's counsel prevails over human plans (Proverbs 19:21). Ultimately, man’s purpose culminates in praising God with all that has breath, recognizing Him as the source and sustainer of life (Psalms 150:6; 138:8).
